description: Run any Python inside Blender with the full bpy API: model, edit meshes, materials, modifiers, animation, import and export files, render. The value of the last expression (or a variable named __result__) is returned, along with everything printed. This is the most flexible Blender tool: use it for anything the other tools do not cover.

code.description: Python source to run. bpy is already imported.

timeout_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the result (default 60, max 600). Raise it for long jobs.

name: blender_execute_python
